evals.name: store-paused-vi
evals.prompt: soi ads store aluckgoodate.com giúp mình, store này đang scale không?
assertions: Calls SpyWinAds tools at most 3 times
Answers in the user's language, incl. table headers
Video age given as date + number of days
Has a limits line: no spend / revenue data
Never claims profit / winning / making sales
Status is Paused (0 live ads), not scaling
Says other stores still run some of its videos when stores_running_now > 0
